notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Adjusted times for S-Rank in some of the later levels, to make it a little easier to get.
- Changes in some enemies that sometimes got stuck on walls in certain levels.
- Removed Herobrine

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with audio when changing volume
- Added an option to show FPS. Press F10 while playing
- Added an option to use an alternative collision method for those who get stuck in walls with low framerate. Press F11 on Options Menu. If you see shurikens at the corners of this screen, you're using the alternative collision method
